verdict.rationale: Airwallex has a disputes page stating it will "facilitate your dispute management step-by-step," so some chargeback handling exists for payments merchants. Nothing in the pack shows how evidence is submitted or how dispute status is tracked through to resolution. Missing for 10: documented structured evidence submission (fields or file uploads), dispute lifecycle states and status tracking, dispute-specific webhooks or API endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
